findings: Source JPG and formal PNG preserve all five track/locus alternatives: A rounded both, B sharp peaks/rounded valleys, C plateaus, D sharp both, E rounded peaks/sharp valleys. Existing wheel and native path features are small but visible at768px. In the second design red circle/curve pairing is qualitative curvature, not a claim that the sampled A bend is an exact circle of the physical wheel radius. The mathematical exclusion of any smooth valley follows from the two straight-face contact constraints.
